verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the Gemini Apps Privacy Hub. It states that users can export their information and links to Google Takeout, which is a first-party export path for Gemini data. It is documented for the consumer Gemini Apps surface, not specifically for Gemini API project data such as uploaded files, cached content, batch outputs or tuned models. missing for 10: evidence that Gemini API project data (files, batch results, tuned models, interaction history) can be exported, confirmation that exports use open formats, evidence that the export covers all data, documented account/project exit or deletion flow for API users, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: You can request the removal of content under our policies or applicable laws. You can also export your information.
